metadata.image-alt: An illustrated TTRPG setting depicting a vibrant, detailed blue market building with bustling activity, stairs, lanterns, and annotated notes for game design.
metadata.image-description: This illustration presents an intricately detailed scene intended as a tabletop roleplaying game (TTRPG) opening scenario. The central feature is a vivid, blue-painted market building bustling with activity, featuring multiple floors and outdoor staircases connecting levels. Warm lantern lights illuminate various market stalls and interior spaces, creating an inviting and immersive atmosphere. Figures interact in small groups around crates and tables, suggesting active engagement and layered storytelling opportunities. Surrounding the image are handwritten annotations and design notes, hinting at hidden secrets, puzzles, and narrative possibilities integral to immersive gameplay. This richly illustrated environment enhances player engagement and narrative depth, perfect for detailed exploration in a TTRPG session.

coverImageAlt: Three ornate fantasy weapons rest on a slate museum plinth linked by an orange display cord.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: Rich tabletop fantasy weapon description represented by a curator's still life in which three distinct handcrafted weapon silhouettes reveal material, history, and character through texture and dramatic light, conveying evocative item writing without depicting combat.
Scene/backdrop: A warm-paper museum alcove with a dark slate display plinth.
Subject: Three safely arranged fantasy artifacts—a short weathered sword, an ornate crescent axe, and a slender spearhead—made from stone, dark wood, navy metal, and cyan enamel, with one small orange cord tying the composition together; no hands or people.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; one crop-safe triangular tabletop still life with readable silhouettes; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: storied, tactile, mysterious, reverent rather than violent
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: static museum presentation only; no blood, injury, combat, people, heraldic glyphs, inscriptions, runes, or decorative writing; completely original image; no input or reference images; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, watermark, product UI, vendor branding, Microsoft Fluent styling, paw imagery, paw logo, cats, or cat silhouettes
